purpose: Text-to-sound-effects prompt adherence, cleanliness, layering, and practical editability

cases.prompt: Quiet modern server room ambience at night: steady low ventilation hum, faint cooling fans, one subtle relay click in the distance. Clean stereo field, no music, no speech, no alarm.
A person in leather boots takes six measured steps across wet concrete, then stops. Close Foley recording, realistic shoe impacts and small water splashes, no voices, no music.
A heavy drinking glass is placed gently on a wooden table, slides a few centimetres, then a fingertip taps the rim once. Dry studio Foley, precise sequence, no music, no speech.
Futuristic spacecraft console sequence: three soft confirmation beeps, a short holographic shimmer, then a deep power-up pulse. Polished cinematic sound design, no melody, no speech.
Large mechanical vault lock opening: motor engages, gears rotate, four metal bolts retract in sequence, final heavy clunk. Detailed close perspective, no music, no speech.
A summer thunderstorm heard from inside a quiet room: rain against a closed window, one distant thunder roll, subtle room resonance. No voices, no music, no breaking glass.
A small friendly fantasy creature wakes up, stretches with a soft chirrup, sniffs twice, then makes one pleased purring trill. Expressive but nonverbal, no human words, no music.
Short cinematic scene transition: airy reverse swell into a tight low-frequency impact with a brief metallic tail. Production-ready, strong but not clipped, no music, no speech.
